Overview

The Extending Conveyor is a conveyor that can be found and purchased at Alan's Autologistics for $990. It's appearance is a green, unlabeled box found at the back of the store. When placed, it is a small conveyor strip and conveyor supports that shows the total area it is taking up.

When resized or stretched, the strip will stay the same size, but the conveyor supports will be resized. When the conveyor is activated, the conveyor will take up the conveyor support area, making a typical conveyor.

Usage

This conveyor can be used for complex builds and precise builds, in which an unanchored item has to fall down.
